current_prompt.body:
DETERMINE whether the list L of 45 distinct positive integers (N=15) can be partitioned into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that a_i + b_i = c_i for each triple.
IF a valid partition exists THEN
    RETURN one complete example of such a partition.
ENDIF

current_plan.body:
GENERATE all triples (a, b, c) from L where a + b = c
FORMULATE the exact cover problem of selecting 15 disjoint triples that cover all elements of L
SOLVE the exact cover problem using an appropriate algorithm (e.g., backtracking or dancing links)
IF a solution is found THEN
    OUTPUT the selected 15 triples as the partition
ELSE
    INDICATE that no valid partition exists
ENDIF
